title: Week 22 Check-In · The Whipping Boy
description: This week you looked back at the whole book: how Jemmy and the prince changed, what the story teaches, a scene read out loud, and your finished comparison paragraph. You practiced pronouns, the root struct, and compound words. Show what you know!

questions.text: Write 2–3 sentences that say what Jemmy learned and what the prince learned. Use one detail from the book for each boy.

passage.title: Reading passage (from Chapter 17)
passage.text:
Jemmy watched the prince slowly raise himself off the mud flat. He felt a growing amazement. … There was a cast-iron streak of pluck in him.
“Steady on your legs?” Jemmy asked.
“Steady.”
… “Does everyone hate me?”
“More’n likely.”
“What about you?”
Jemmy hesitated for a moment. “I did. But maybe I don’t.” Jemmy couldn’t sort out his feelings.
